modules.module_title: Prepare for the sale of food products

pcs.pc_description: procure the required quantity of food products from stores, warehouses, etc. as per supervisor’s instructions
move food products to the designated place safely in adherence with standard work practices
unpack and sort the food stock at designated place appropriately
record stock delivery information as per standard work practices. Stock delivery information: based on type; quantity; consumer demand, shelf-life of products, etc.
inspect the stocks received for desired appropriateness (such as packaging, labelling, quality, etc.)
label the food products for identification
place the labelled products in respective shelves/places safely as per shelf life, sale preference, First In First Out (FIFO), First Expiry First Out (FEFO), First Manufactured First Out (FMFO), etc.
set the required temperature of refrigeration unit for storing the food products
obtain merchandise, materials and equipment required for visual merchandising of food products. Materials: product labels, price tickets, associated equipment, chair, tables, banners, signages, etc.
unpack the food products and materials to be displayed
clean the work area thoroughly before placing the materials for merchandising
arrange the food products to be sold at designated places appropriately ensuring maximum visibility and accessibility to the customers
display food products using appropriate labels and price tickets as per standard operating procedure
replenish the out-of-stock food items and replace the damaged food products and dispose them safely
monitor the display for appearance and required levels of cleanliness periodically as per work schedule

modules.module_title: Sell and promote food products to customers

pcs.pc_description: identify the customer requirements by assessing their needs and interests including organoleptic evaluation. Organoleptic evaluation: taste, colour, appearance, odour, etc.
prepare sample food items for the customers such as ready-to-eat products
dispose the used plates, glasses, etc. appropriately
wrap, package or plate food items as per standard practices
provide product information to the customer appropriately. Product information: such as variants, nutritional value, pricing, new launches/promotions, etc.
address customer issues and complaints with respect to the desired food product and services using current and accurate information
calculate sale price information and generate invoice as per the products sold
confirm the amount to be paid by the customer and process payments for the products sold as per the mode of payment

modules.module_title: Maintain food products in retail stores and promotion sites

pcs.pc_description: identify physical, chemical and biological hazards that could affect the quality of stored food products
inspect the quality of food products and identify damaged, deteriorated, spoiled or out of date food items
mark to identify and separate food products until disposal of damaged products is complete
identify potentially damaged food from the storage space appropriately
record required information (such as spoiled food items, equipment breakdowns, etc.) as per organisational work process
rotate the stocks as per sales preference and manufacturing date
maintain appropriate environmental conditions for storing perishable items. Environmental Conditions: absence of materials that can cause contamination; required freshness, quality, appearance, etc.
monitor the heating and cooling processes to ensure required microbiological safety of food
clean and sanitise food handling equipment, implements, surfaces and utensils as per standard practices
segregate broken, chipped or cracked food handling equipment safely
inspect the work area to ensure it is free from insects, pests, vermin, etc.
report issues such as faulty equipment, food spoilage, pest infestations, etc. to the supervisor
